name: Maxence Fontana

portrait.alt: Maxence Fontana in front of a mural with French and American symbols

bio: I’m a mechanical engineer working in international business development. At Business France in Los Angeles, I help French aerospace and space companies understand the North American market, identify potential partners, and prepare for commercial conversations.

Before moving to Los Angeles, I worked at Airbus Helicopters during my engineering apprenticeship and spent a summer with Messer Americas in Toronto. My work has ranged from aircraft configuration and engineering tools to organizing programs that bring companies and industry teams together.

featured.title: French Space Days and SmallSat
featured.description: I helped coordinate the France Pavilion at SmallSat in Salt Lake City and organize the Los Angeles program, including meetings, site visits, and the closing reception. The programs brought French space companies together with North American industry teams.

featured.title: Parts classification at Airbus Helicopters
featured.description: For my final engineering project, I worked on automating part identification and classification. The public summary is limited to the problem and my contribution.

featured.title: Guit’Art
featured.description: I built and publicly demonstrated a portable electric guitar prototype with an integrated amplifier.

projects.title: Seoul or Saoul
projects.description: I built a travel companion for Seoul and Busan with neighborhood maps and optional quests. The prototype explores how to plan a trip while leaving room for detours.

experience.title: Aerospace Trade Advisor
details: Support French aerospace and space companies with North American market research and business development.
Coordinate meetings and industry programs with French and North American partners.

experience.title: Mechanical engineering apprenticeship
details: Worked on 3D helicopter configurations and a capstone project on part identification and classification.

beyond.title: Travel and photography
beyond.description: I enjoy mountain trips and photographing places I visit. One of my strongest memories of Japan is looking out at Mount Fuji from a dock in Hakone.

beyond.title: Chess and music
beyond.description: I helped start chess clubs at Arts et Métiers and play the cello.

beyond.title: Reading
beyond.description: Recent reading includes Foundation by Isaac Asimov and Ignorance by Milan Kundera.
